production_rules: Production must render exactly three 1080x1620 portrait pages.
Page 1: item 1 hero + item 2 and item 3 secondary cards.
Page 2: item 4 and item 5 full-width editorial stories with STACORP notes.
Page 3: executive summary, exactly three executive actions, five highlights, source list and closing visual.
Final pages are rendered deterministically from HTML/CSS; ChatGPT Images creates story illustrations only.
Experimental layouts must never be used by production.
Layout changes require explicit user approval.
